original_test_intent: Verify that the current owner-approved BIOS configuration can be stored through the Save as User Defaults control as the platform's user-default profile.
original_method: Capture the current configuration and any existing user-default ownership, invoke Save as User Defaults in the BIOS UI, observe the save confirmation/profile state, and preserve the active operational configuration.
manual_activity: A human must review the configuration to be captured, select Save as User Defaults, respond to any overwrite confirmation and observe the firmware profile result. A software export cannot exercise this BIOS control.
required_inputs: Existing User Defaults state and owner
OOB recovery and desired final profile state
safety_requirements: Do not overwrite an unidentified or recovery-critical user-default profile.
Capture the complete source configuration and existing profile state before saving.
Keep the operational configuration active unless a separate activation test is approved.
Do not use Restore User Defaults as implicit proof if it would introduce unapproved state changes.
Stop on unexpected overwrite, active-setting change or management/boot risk.
agent_execution_scope: Collect identity, read-only configuration/profile evidence and compare captures.
Track overwrite approval and whether active settings remained unchanged.
Do not operate firmware UI, authorize profile replacement or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact profile content and overwrite/final-state disposition.
Perform and capture Save as User Defaults and any documented non-destructive verification.
Determine whether the profile save satisfies the source criterion.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects an agent command substitute. Stored-profile confirmation fits the source; full recall is useful only when separately approved because it can modify active settings and overlaps the next Restore User Defaults case.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the interactive Save as User Defaults control and use platform profile status or explicit firmware confirmation where available; do not replace it with a configuration export.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Save as User Defaults, no-script state and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record current configuration and prior user-default metadata/content, obtain overwrite approval, capture the exact profile-save action and firmware acknowledgment, then verify stored-profile availability through the least state-changing documented method while confirming active settings are unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board and BIOS user-default implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC and any profile-capture format versions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds profile identity, overwrite ownership and active-state preservation to the generic save check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; a destructive recall is separated from this save case unless explicitly approved as extra verification.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved profile, prior-profile disposition and platform verification semantics.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some firmware exposes no non-destructive profile inspection, so recall validation may need the separate Restore User Defaults case.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose the profile content and non-destructive verification method. A recall cycle must be recorded as additional scope and must not erase the independent coverage of Restore User Defaults.
expected_evidence: Identity, approval, current configuration and prior-profile state
Save as User Defaults action and firmware confirmation
Stored-profile availability evidence using the approved method
Unchanged active configuration, health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Criteria consistently address saving a settings profile. The source omits profile identity and overwrite/verification detail, but no source statements require opposite behavior.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The profile-save intent is clear. Platform documentation, target profile and overwrite approval are readiness inputs, not a permanent semantic block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with its manual boundary but limits recallability to an approved verification extension rather than an unstated mandatory action.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its overwrite protection, baseline and recovery controls while separating profile save from the next restore case.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes missing execution inputs from BLOCKED and protects adjacent-case coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents an existing recovery profile from being silently overwritten and prevents a potentially disruptive restore from being smuggled into a save-only case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The BIOS UI control and overwrite confirmation are the function under test, so human operation and observation are central. Automated configuration comparison is supporting evidence only; MANUAL ONLY is therefore correct.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat Save as User Defaults after an unexpected overwrite, missing confirmation or profile-state ambiguity; preserve the first result and obtain engineer disposition.
